viewpoint._说明: 画家视角：照着 images/art-of-painting.jpg 算的。地砖的透视显示视平线在画面高度约 60% 处、模特的手附近；画家和模特的身高都对得上眼睛离地约 0.85 米（坐着看）。离开视角点后，慢慢升到走路的高度。

text.zh: 从这里看，就是画里的样子。
text.en: From here, you see what the painting sees.

text.zh: 一块厚重的挂毯帘子被拉到一边，好像邀请我们走进这个房间。
text.en: A heavy tapestry curtain is drawn aside, as if inviting us into the room.

text.zh: 画家背对着我们，坐在画架前作画。维米尔把一个工作室里的日常场景，变成了“绘画艺术”的寓言。
text.en: The painter sits at his easel with his back to us. Vermeer turned an everyday studio scene into an allegory of the art of painting.

text.zh: 模特装扮成历史女神克利俄。她启发画家，并宣告绘画的荣耀，把它写进历史之书。
text.en: The model poses as Clio, Muse of history, who inspires the painter and proclaims the glory of painting, recording it in the book of history.

text.zh: 画家刚开始画，画布上只画了一点点。
text.en: The painter has only just begun; there is very little on the canvas so far.

text.zh: 桌上有雕塑模型和素描本。它们和画架上的画一起，表现了各门艺术的统一。
text.en: On the table are a sculptor's model and a sketchbook. Together with the painting on the easel, they reflect the unity of the arts.

text.zh: 墙上的地图，画的是南北分裂之前的尼德兰十七省，指向一片一直因绘画而闻名的土地。
text.en: The map shows the 17 provinces of the Netherlands before they were divided into north and south, a land that had always owed its fame to painting.

text.zh: 维米尔把自己的名字签在了地图下方的边框上：“I Ver-Meer”。
text.en: Vermeer signed his name on the lower border of the map: "I Ver-Meer".

exclusive._说明: 独家发现：①“拉开帘子”：开场时面前挡着一块挂毯帘子，只露出房间的一角；点一下，帘子淡出，完整的工作室出现。②“找签名”：画面上浮现一个框，圈出地图下方边框上的签名“I Ver-Meer”，并显示卡片7的文字（lines 是框在原画上的位置，照着原画量的：模特头部右边、地图下边框上）。

caption.zh: 约1666/68年 · 维也纳艺术史博物馆

title.zh: 第一幕 · 画家的工作室

text.zh: 大约1666到1668年，维米尔画下了一位在工作室里作画的画家。他让模特装扮成历史女神，把这个日常场景，变成了一首献给绘画的寓言。
text.en: Around 1666–68, Vermeer painted an artist at work in his studio. Dressing the model as the Muse of history, he turned this everyday scene into an allegory of the art of painting.

alt.zh: 维米尔《绘画艺术》约1666/68，维也纳艺术史博物馆
alt.en: Johannes Vermeer, The Art of Painting, about 1666/68, Kunsthistorisches Museum, Vienna

caption.zh: 约1666/68年 · 维也纳艺术史博物馆

text.zh: 维米尔去世后，这幅画留在他的遗孀卡塔琳娜手里。1676年，她把画转给了自己的母亲。第二年，它在代尔夫特被拍卖。
text.en: After Vermeer's death, the painting remained with his widow, Catharina. In 1676 she passed it to her mother, and the following year it was auctioned in Delft.

alt.zh: 维米尔《绘画艺术》约1666/68，维也纳艺术史博物馆
alt.en: Johannes Vermeer, The Art of Painting, about 1666/68, Kunsthistorisches Museum, Vienna

caption.zh: 约1666/68年 · 维也纳艺术史博物馆

title.zh: 第三幕 · 漫长的旅程

text.zh: 它后来来到维也纳，1813年起属于切尔宁伯爵。1940年，它被希特勒占有；战后，1946年移交给艺术史博物馆，1958年正式成为馆藏。今天，它挂在第十二展厅。
text.en: It later came to Vienna, and from 1813 belonged to Count Czernin. In 1940 it was acquired by Adolf Hitler. After the war, in 1946, it was handed over to the Kunsthistorisches Museum, and formally joined the collection in 1958. Today it hangs in Room XII.

final.zh: 画家背对着我们，让我们看他作画。
final.en: The painter turns his back to us, and lets us watch him paint.
